entries.title: Picking a project or kind by its name no longer crashes the app
entries.body: In Settings, Usage, clicking a project's or a kind's name in the Projects and Kinds menus under Cost per task crashed the window. The click now ticks that choice and leaves the menu open, as clicking its checkbox does.
entries.noPicture: The menus look the same as before; only the click on a name no longer crashes the window.
